items.summary: Fix all bugs in the Jap section (frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx): resolve any state management issues causing incorrect or inconsistent nam jap count display, fix tap handler debouncing or double-counting problems, ensure the session count and daily count both update correctly and reliably on every tap/press, and prevent any race conditions between local state and backend sync that cause the counter to skip, reset unexpectedly, or display stale values.

Implement smooth, lag-free nam jap counting in the Jap section: use optimistic local state updates (increment a local ref or state immediately on tap before any async backend call) so the counter visually increments instantly without waiting for backend responses. Debounce or batch backend sync calls so frequent taps do not trigger excessive re-renders or network requests that cause UI jank.

Add a circular or linear progress bar to the Jap section (frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx) that fills progressively as the nam jap count increases toward the 108-bead cycle. The progress bar should visually represent progress from 0 to 108 (one mala), reset and refill for each subsequent mala cycle, and display the current count and target (e.g., '45 / 108') alongside it. Use saffron/gold devotional colors consistent with the app theme.
